Congenital bilateral dislocation of the elbow joints.
TTC8-related retinal degeneration; rod-cone dystrophy and visual impairment in 4/4. Other ciliopathy manifestations are not established here.

Severe cerebral dysfunction defined by its association with hepatic failure or portosystemic shunting.
Primary antibody deficiency; recurrent sinus, respiratory and ear infections do not establish lasting organ damage and are separately diagnosed infections.
